[EN] Search and Destroy
[ES] Buscar y destruir
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Elleon sent a message. Go to Firebase Valor at Fyrmount and speak with Elleon.
[ES] Elleon envió un mensaje. Ve a Firebase Valor en Fyrmount y habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the cave southeast of Firebase Valor, and use the {@LinkCreature:204#1501#teleportal}. Speak with Elleon. [You must select Akasha's Hideout (Solo) from the {@LinkCreature:204#1501#Teleportal} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Encuentra la cueva al sureste de Firebase Valor y usa el {@LinkCreature:204#1501#teleportal}. Habla con Elleon. [Debes seleccionar Akasha's Hideout (Solo) desde el {@LinkCreature:204#1501#Teleportal} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate Garion to open the first gate.
[ES] Elimina a Garion para abrir la primera puerta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate Adanok to open the second gate.
[ES] Elimina a Adanok para abrir la segunda puerta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Elleon.
[ES] Habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate Nadaim, Guardian of Epidemics, to open the third gate.
[ES] Elimina a Nadaim, Guardián de Epidemias, para abrir la tercera puerta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Karascha and operate the strange seal. [Summons Gilgash's Pylon or Akakalash's Pylon]
[ES] Derrota a Karascha y opera el extraño sello. [Invoca el pilar de Gilgash o el pilar de Akakalash]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It will be for Akasha."
[ES] "Será para Akasha."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Investigate the Plagueheart. [Eliminate Lugribar or Shargrim to summon the Plagueheart.]
[ES] Investiga el Plagueheart. [Elimina a Lugribar o Shargrim para invocar el Plagueheart.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
